result.title: Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance
result.summary: The rapid deployment of agentic AI has introduced complex challenges for the ethics and governance of AI systems. Agents built on large language models act through tools on behalf of people, and each deployment case brings its own instructions, policies, evidence, and stakeholders, so alignment must be formed case by case. To this end, this work proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a computational reflective equilibrium framework that serves as an ethical alignment scaffold in the agent harness. Drawing inspiration from the reflective equilibrium of John Rawls, the scaffold links principles from the system prompt and operator policy, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, with provenance encoding the instruction hierarchy. The agent acts on an equilibrium of this state and calls tools or asks questions only while doing so is worth its cost, unless a due-diligence mandate requires them. Governance enters through value priorities, source authority, prohibitions, human-in-the-loop triggers, and mandates, and certificates attribute each action to the sources whose commitments drove it. We show that equilibria are Nash equilibria of a mutual-adjustment game and establish monotonicity, lexical priority, stability certificates, and a quarantine theorem for prompt injection. Two case studies illustrate the framework: a computer-use assistant told to win a refund "whatever it takes" files an honest warranty claim, refuses a fake review, and ignores an injected request for personal data; a hiring agent showcases how authority, oversight triggers, audit mandates, and hard prohibitions shape discrimination, privacy violations, and escalation. The framework offers traceability, coherence, and adaptivity, facilitating safe, secure, and trustworthy agentic AI.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 agentic reflective equilibrium（ARE）框架：在 agent harness 中用类型化的支持与攻击关系连接系统提示与运营政策原则、审慎判断、工具证据和候选动作，代理在均衡状态下行动，仅在调用工具或提问的收益高于其成本时执行（除非有尽职义务），并给出均衡的博弈性质与两个治理案例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「仅在收益值得成本时才调用工具/提问」的计算价值门控与何时停止获取证据的规则，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡、证据筛选与停止决策提供远领域的概念线索，需人工核查其形式化条件能否迁移。
